captions: This is Obol, a plugin that lets Hermes Agent handle your invoices,
When a client says “send me the invoice,”
just forward the message to Hermes.
It reads it and drafts the invoice:
who to bill, what for, how much, and when it's due.
No invoice goes out until you approve it.
One tap, and your client gets a secure payment link.
It works in Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, email, or your terminal.
A scammer copies your client's email address,
and asks for invoices to go to a new address, without your approval.
Hermes spots the fake address and blocks it.
Type slash invoices to see what's paid, open and overdue.
Obol. Invoicing for Hermes Agent, with security built in.
